Compatibility redirects and fallbacks should say Admin or domain-specific admin destination text without changing old-link behavior.
Docs and QA guides should call the product Admin while using React only for implementation context, generated assets, historical migration evidence, or technical validation details.
Internal and generated React strings are allowed implementation references unless surfaced through production route responses, browser-visible text, screenshots, redirect copy, or fallback states.
